newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AGA says in French industrial gas venture.
newsitem.headline: AGA says in French industrial gas venture.

text.p: Swedish gas company AGA AB said on Monday it had created a joint venture with Praxair and Air Products for the production of industrial-use gases at Air Product's existing facility near Lyons, France.
"This production joint venture will expand the capacity of the existing plant to 665 tonnes per day of liquid oxygen, nitrogen and argon," AGA said in a statement.
AGA said its share of the total capacity would be 21.5 percent or 144 tonnes per day. Expansion would be ready in 1998, it said.
The company said this would be AGA's fifth production unit for air gases in France and an important complement of the existing supply network.
"Together with the plant presently being built in the Toulouse area it will practically double our capacity available for the merchant market within the next two years," AGA said.
